about.title: Travel is also about designing decisions
about.lead: I'm Kevin, the developer behind this digital journal. I built it to explore how content, interface and a useful tool can coexist in a small project.
about.copy: It is not meant to replace an exhaustive guide. Every destination offers a starting point and a planner for adapting, saving and sharing a route from the browser.
about.quote: “Understand the journey first. Then decide what deserves to be on screen.”
about.imageAlt: A person looking at a mountain landscape at sunset
about.step1Copy: Articles, destinations and stops live in shared data sources. Pages consume the same content without duplication.
about.step2Copy: The itinerary can be arranged, restored and shared without accounts or tracking. State remains under the browser's control.
about.step3Copy: Linting, type checks and static generation are part of the workflow, keeping the published demo aligned with reviewed code.
about.ctaCopy: Start with a city, build your itinerary and see how the project responds on mobile and desktop.
